description: stage_a_obs_fix: Stage A 26B + obs preprocessor (PR #61): vmem OFF, planner OFF, 300 steps target — killed at 158 steps. Preprocessor active ([Full Map] in prompt + map memory accumulating), but agent stayed at y<5 on RedsHouse1f so y≥6 rows stayed '?' — never saw the exit warp.
notes: max_eval=0.00 (0.0/7), 1 ep, 158 steps (killed early); 10 warps all to (7,1). Diagnosis: obs preprocessor is necessary-not-sufficient — accumulates what the screen window covers but can't reveal tiles the agent has never observed. Needs exploration nudge or planner to push the agent toward unexplored regions.

description: stage_c_plus_26b_mmr_decay_t03: Stage C′++ at temperature=0.3 (down from 0.7) — test whether lower sampling temp lets the LLM act on the explicit exit-at-(2,7)/(3,7) prompt hint
notes: max_eval=0.00 (0.0/7), 1 ep, 263 steps (killed early). KEY FINDING: T=0.3 DID change spatial behavior — move_to(3,7)×30, move_to(2,7)×18 (was zero at T=0.7), so the LLM now attends to the location hint. But no successful warp through the exit door — agent walks TO (3,7) but never calls warp_with_warp_point(3,7); only 6 warps total, all to (7,1) staircase. Temperature fixes location-targeting failure mode but exposes a deeper tool-selection failure: action LLM uses move_to where warp_with_warp_point is required.
